After some back-and-forth on, I was finally able to get my hands on the routed GPT-6.2 Sol through a friend.

Here's how they compared:

- GPT-6.2 Sol: Took around 20 minutes and cost $9.
- Opus 5.5: Took 1 hour and cost $20.

Sol nailed the details really well and produced something you'd expect to see in a low-budget animated movie.

Opus 5.5 focused more on the overall environment, and it looked really good too. But I have to be honest, Sol did better here.

context.text:
ChatGPT users are now reportedly being routed to GPT-6.2 Sol, and the 3D demos are wild. Here's what you need to know.

Token Gremlin (@TokenGremlin) posted at 6:45 PM on Nov 8, 2026 that he is being routed to GPT-6.2 Sol. The post has over 84K views. He says it is outperforming Claude Opus 5.5 in his one-shot design and 3D tests so far.

His demo is a black hole, which he calls the best AI-generated one he has seen. It was generated in one shot, built with Three.js, and packed inside a single HTML file. These are scenes from a single prompt, not game screenshots.

This follows the delay we covered yesterday. GPT-6.2 Sol and Astra missed the Nov 7 date The Information had floated. Now some users say routing has started quietly, so a release next week looks likely to them.

How people say they check it: ask GPT-6.1 Sol, with no web search, whether it knows Fable 5. If it answers, you are reportedly routed to 6.2 Sol. One user says it is fast and uses few tool calls, but at xhigh in Codex he found Astra still better.

Doubts remain. One account says this is just GPT-6.1 Sol. Another stresses it is a rumour and that OpenAI has confirmed nothing.

Key numbers:
- 84.6K views on the main post
- One prompt, one shot, one HTML file
- Built with Three.js
- Predicted by one user: Sol on Mon Nov 9, Astra on Thu Nov 12, with prices about 50% below Claude
- Reported pricing target for Sol: under $2 per million tokens, per infrastructure reports
- Claude Opus 5.5 scores 86.32 vs 78.09 for GPT-6 Sol on one public comparison

OpenAI has not announced GPT-6.2 Sol or Astra, and there is no official release date.
